    One-letter extensions of string words #

    Appending one signed arrow adds exactly one endpoint occurrence to the word. This file constructs the embedding of all old prefix positions into the extended word and the induced linear inclusion and projection on vertex spaces. These are the coordinate maps underlying the canonical hook and cohook morphisms.
